Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's half guard passing in ten volumes, organised by what the bottom player does. Volume 1 covers the concepts that simplify half guard. Volume 2 covers the ankle scoop to back step or mount. Volume 3 covers the low knee shield. Volume 4 covers the double leg and butterfly half guard. Volume 5 covers basic passes to side control and mount. Volume 6 is a long section on leg riding and the far-foot grab. Volume 7 covers the scorpion and 'scoop scorpion'. Volume 8 covers passing when the bottom player has a near-side underhook. Volumes 9 and 10 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi passers who end up in half guard a lot.
key: Ankle scoop to back step or mount
Beating the low knee shield and butterfly half
Leg riding and the far-foot grab

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's leg lock system in eight volumes. Volume 1 covers the overview. Volume 2 covers irimi ashi garami (setting it). Volume 3 covers outside ashi and how it differs from irimi ashi. Volume 4 covers toe holds and belly-down exposure. Volume 5 is a long section on cross ashi and its leg positions. Volume 6 covers 50/50 ('attack until you're defending'). Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls (Placido, Nathalia) with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi grapplers building a heel hook game.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's turtle attacks in eight volumes (the folder's Contents.txt has timestamps). Volume 1 covers grips, breaking a closed turtle down to side control, the seated head-and-arm, diagonal control and the first hook. Volume 2 covers the cross body ride, getting the second hook, the power half nelson and transitions to the armbar and triangles. Volume 3 covers the open turtle (reverse tight waist, cross body ride back takes, calf slice, hammer lock, guillotine). Volume 4 covers the open/closed elbow dilemma, the back head-and-arm roll-through, using a strangle to break the turtle down, and wrist rides and rear body locks. Volume 5 covers the crucifix, crackdown and rolling the opponent with a strangle. Volume 6 covers countering rolls and stand-ups. Volumes 7 and 8 are rolling breakdowns and rolls.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi top players who want to get past the turtle to the back.
key: Cross body ride and hook insertion
